mktE10.heroiTexto: Menu, floor, kitchen and website on the same base. No exporting, no retyping, no copying prices from one spreadsheet to another.
mktE10.irParaInicio: BossaOS, go to the home page
mktE10.produtoTitulo: One base for every part of service
mktE10.produtoTexto: What you change in one place changes everywhere. That is what keeps the printed menu and the digital one from contradicting each other.
mktE10.planosTexto: Start where it hurts and grow when you need to.
mktE10.comecamosTexto: Four steps, and none of them leaves you stranded mid-service.
mktE10.demoTexto: Half an hour, with your own menu in front of you. No generic pitch.
mktE10.confiancaTitulo: A base you can work on with confidence
mktE10.confiancaTexto: Your data is yours, and the system says what it does not know instead of making it up.
mktE10.pilotoTexto: We work alongside you during a real service, not in a training room.
mktE10.obrigadoTitulo: Your request is on its way
mktE10.obrigadoTexto: We will write within one working day to agree a time.
mktE10.naoEncontradoTitulo: We could not find this page
mktE10.naoEncontradoTexto: The link may have changed. Everything is reachable from the home page.
mktE10.cartaoCartaTexto: Prices, allergens and availability are written once and come out the same on the printed menu, the QR and the website.
mktE10.cartaoSalaTexto: What is ordered at the table reaches the kitchen without anyone retyping it.
mktE10.cartaoWebTexto: The restaurant website comes from the same place as the menu, and goes live when you say so.
mktE10.confianca1Texto: Export it whenever you want, in a format any spreadsheet opens.
mktE10.confianca2: We say what we do not know
mktE10.confianca2Texto: An undeclared allergen shows as unknown, never as "does not contain".
mktE10.confianca3Texto: The database refuses to read another restaurant’s data, and that is checked on every release.
mktE10.confianca4: Off the network, the limit is stated
mktE10.confianca4Texto: Writing an order and leaving it queued keeps working with no connection, and the screen does not call it sent until it actually leaves. What needs the server is bounded, and it is this:
mktE10.confianca4Nota: None of them can be composed without a connection, and the system says so with the reason in front of you instead of letting you press and wait.
mktE10.confianca1Prova: You check it yourself: export and open the file. It does not depend on us doing it for you.
mktE10.confianca2Prova: The catalogue tells «not declared» apart from «does not contain», and that difference is checked dish by dish before publishing.
mktE10.confianca3Prova: It is not a rule of the program: the database itself refuses the read, and that is verified on every deploy.
mktE10.confianca4Prova: The list of what needs the server is closed and lives in one place: the same one the system uses to refuse is the one you see above.
mktE10.confiancaPaginaTexto: The home page tells you what we promise. Here is how you can verify it yourself, without taking our word.
mktE10.pilotoPagina: What a pilot is, and what it is not
mktE10.pilotoPaginaTexto: A real service with your menu and your team, with us inside it. Here is what happens, in what order, and what each side commits to — because a pilot that only commits one side is not a pilot.
mktE10.pilotoOQueETexto: An agreement with its own term and conditions, separate from the subscription. Your menu goes into the system and a real service is worked, with the people who will use it.
mktE10.pilotoNosTexto: To loading your menu from whatever you already have, to being in the house during the service, and to telling you what the system does not do yet rather than steering around it. If something is not built, you say it once and you know it up front.
mktE10.pilotoTuTexto: To using it in a real service rather than a quiet rehearsal, and to telling us what breaks. A pilot nobody complains about has measured nothing.
mktE10.pilotoSaidaTexto: You take your data. The export exists and does not depend on us running it: it downloads in a format any spreadsheet opens. There is nothing to rescue over the phone.
mktE10.pilotoStarter: And there is a tier you can set up yourself
mktE10.pilotoStarterTexto: Starter can be rolled out unaccompanied and with no onboarding cost. It is not the only way to start, but it is the one that does not depend on our calendar.
mktE10.pilotoSemNomes: Why you will see no names here
mktE10.pilotoSemNomesTexto: Because publishing a restaurant name is their decision and not ours, and we have not asked yet. When we ask and they say yes, it will appear. Before that, a logo on this page would be a signature nobody gave.
mktE10.passo1Texto: Half an hour to see how you work today. No generic pitch.
mktE10.passo2Texto: We bring it in from whatever you already have, even a PDF or a spreadsheet.
mktE10.passo3Texto: We are in the house during a real service, not in a training room.
mktE10.passo4Texto: You are left with everything running, and someone to call if it goes sideways.
mktE10.faq1: Do I have to change my POS?
mktE10.faq1Texto: Not to start. Menu, QR and website work with the POS you already have.
mktE10.faq2: What if I want to leave?
mktE10.faq2Texto: You take your exported data with you. There is no penalty for leaving.
mktE10.faq3: What if I have no website?
mktE10.faq3Texto: We build it from your menu. You only decide when it goes live.
mktE10.faq4: What happens if the connection drops mid-service?
mktE10.faq4Texto: What's already written is not lost: it stays on the device itself, and we never say “sent” about something still on the phone. When the connection returns, one tap sends it, and before retrying we ask the server whether it already arrived. Payments still need the server, and the screen says why.
mktE10.faq5: Do I have to buy new hardware to start?
mktE10.faq5Texto: Possibly not. With a computer to administer and the code printed on the table, the menu already works. The floor and the till may ask for more, and that depends on how you work: it is settled with you before anything is bought.
mktE10.faq6: I already have a terminal and a printer. Will they work?
mktE10.faq6Texto: They are assessed before anything is bought, but no model is universally compatible without homologation. We test yours and tell you what fits and what does not, rather than promising up front.
mktE10.faq7: What is NOT included in the subscription?
mktE10.faq7Texto: The hardware, and with it purchase, warranty, network, mounting and cabling. Kiosk and marketplace connectors are quoted separately. We sell no closed kit: the list comes out of how you work.
mktE10.faq8Texto: Yes, in both directions. The system shows you what changes — and what you lose if you move down — before you confirm it, and your data is kept.
mktE10.faq9: Is the year paid in one go?
mktE10.faq9Texto: Yes, up front, and it costs ten monthly payments instead of twelve. The monthly equivalent shown on the plans is a division for comparison, not what is charged.
mktE10.faq10Texto: Not on monthly: cancelling stops the next renewal. A paid year runs to the end of the period, and when you leave you take your data exported.
mktE10.demoErro: We could not save your request
mktE10.demoErroTexto: Nothing was saved. Please try again in a moment.
mktE10.demoRepetido: We already had this request. We did not duplicate it.
mktE10.precoAnualExplicado: A year costs ten monthly payments: two you do not pay.
mktE10.planoStarterQuem: To start with the menu, the QR code and the website.
mktE10.planoRestaurantQuem: For those already running floor and kitchen at once.
mktE10.planoProQuem: For those adding till, stock and financial management.
mktE10.precoImplantacaoAparte: Onboarding is paid once and sits outside the subscription.
mktE10.problemaTitulo: Right now the same information lives in four places
mktE10.problemaTexto: And none of them is in charge. Each holds a different version of the same dish.
mktE10.problema1: The menu as a PDF, the till, and a notebook
mktE10.problema1Texto: You change a price in one place and the other two still say yesterday.
mktE10.problema2Texto: What is ordered at the table is copied out by hand for the kitchen, and every copy is a chance to get it wrong.
mktE10.problema3: Nobody knows what is in that dish
mktE10.problema3Texto: The allergen lives in the head of whoever cooked it, not somewhere you can look it up.
mktE10.problema4: The website belongs to someone else
mktE10.problema4Texto: Changing an opening time or a price goes through an agency, an email and an invoice.
mktE10.papeisTitulo: Everyone sees their own screen, over the same base
mktE10.papeisTexto: Four people, four different screens, one catalogue behind them.
mktE10.movimentoTexto: The same order crosses five moments with nobody retyping it. Each step receives what the previous one wrote.
mktE10.movimento1Texto: From your site, from the table code, or from the floor. It comes in once.
mktE10.movimento2Texto: On the screen, in order, with time counted from the server and never from the tablet clock.
mktE10.movimento3Texto: Ready when ALL tasks are: with the second-to-last done, the order still is not.
mktE10.movimento4Texto: And this one needs the server: with no connection the system says so with the reason in front, instead of letting you press and wait.
mktE10.movimento5Texto: Without being typed again anywhere. What was charged is what was ordered.
mktE10.modulosTexto: These are not modules bought separately: they are parts of one system, and all of them read from the same catalogue.
mktE10.modulo1Texto: A dish is written once and shows on the public menu, on the order and in the kitchen. Changing a price does not touch bills already open.
mktE10.modulo2Texto: Tables, sessions and who serves what. Composing an order works with no network; the screen never calls it sent until it leaves.
mktE10.modulo3Texto: Tasks by station, with the state of each. What is marked here is what the floor sees.
mktE10.modulo4Texto: What was sold, what was charged and what is missing. When an indicator has not been measured, it says so instead of showing a zero.
mktE10.papel1Texto: The catalogue, the prices and what happened during service, without asking anyone for a report.
mktE10.papel2Texto: Takes the order standing up, one-handed; what they write reaches the kitchen without being written again.
mktE10.papel3Texto: A screen with what needs preparing, in order, timed from the server and never from the tablet clock.
mktE10.papel4Texto: Points at the table code and reads today's menu, with declared allergens and the price that will actually be charged.
mktE10.equipamentosTitulo: The software is what you pay for. The hardware sits apart.
mktE10.equipamentosTexto: The subscription covers BossaOS. What you already own is assessed before anything is bought, and nothing is universally compatible without homologation.
mktE10.equipamento1: Starting may need no new hardware
mktE10.equipamento1Texto: With a computer to administer and the code printed on the table, the menu already works.
mktE10.equipamento2: The floor may call for staff devices
mktE10.equipamento2Texto: And a screen or a device for the kitchen, depending on how you work. A TV may need a mini-PC.
mktE10.equipamento3: The till may call for a terminal, printer, drawer or scanner
mktE10.equipamento3Texto: It depends on the operation, and every model goes through homologation before being signed off.
mktE10.equipamento4: What is not included, said up front
mktE10.equipamento4Texto: Purchase, warranty, network, mounting and cabling are not implied. Kiosk and marketplace connectors are add-ons where they apply.
mktE10.pilotoAcordo: A pilot is agreed separately, with its own term and conditions.
mktE10.ctaFinalTitulo: Half an hour, with your own menu in front of you
mktE10.ctaFinalTexto: We show you BossaOS with your dishes and your prices, not a generic demo. If it fits, we talk timelines; if it does not, we say so.
mktE10.planosPaginaTexto: The three tiers, what changes between them, and what it costs to start. No small print at the end.
mktE10.recomendaStarter: Right if your menu changes more than your floor does
mktE10.recomendaStarterTexto: Covers the digital menu, the QR code and the website. No floor, no kitchen: if orders go on paper today and that works, do not pay to replace it yet.
mktE10.recomendaRestaurant: Right if the order gets written twice
mktE10.recomendaRestaurantTexto: Adds bookings, floor and kitchen screen. This is the tier that removes the hand-copy between table and pass, which is where time goes and mistakes appear.
mktE10.recomendaPro: Right if you already take payment and buy through the system
mktE10.recomendaProTexto: Adds till and inventory. It makes sense once cashing up and purchase control are daily work, not while they are still a monthly spreadsheet.
mktE10.compararTexto: Three families, and the difference between tiers always sits in one of them.
mktE10.implantacaoTitulo: Onboarding is paid once, and it is not the subscription
mktE10.implantacaoTexto: Two different things, on the invoice and in time: the subscription is monthly or yearly; onboarding is a single payment at the start.
mktE10.implantacaoStarterNota: Starter is the only tier you can set up yourself, at no onboarding cost. The other two always come accompanied.
mktE10.implantacaoPagina: What happens between your yes and the first service
mktE10.implantacaoPaginaTexto: The four steps, what onboarding costs, and what is worth having ready before we start. We would rather you read it now than find it out on installation day.
mktE10.implantacaoHeroiLegenda: The floor on a tablet: the device in the hand of whoever is serving during the accompanied shift.
mktE10.passo1Detalhe: You need not prepare anything. We ask how many tables you have, who takes the order today and how you get paid; the right tier falls out of that. If Starter is enough for you, we say so.
mktE10.passo2Detalhe: Send it however you hold it — a PDF, a spreadsheet or the printed menu — and we load it. The catalogue that comes out is the single base: the public menu, the floor order and the kitchen screen all read from it.
mktE10.passo3Detalhe: We are in the house during a real service, with the team that will use it. Hours of accompaniment depend on the tier, and they are just below with the price beside them.
mktE10.passo4Detalhe: You are left with the system running and someone to call. Monthly carries no lock-in: cancelling stops the next renewal. The year is paid up front and runs to the end of the paid period.
mktE10.implantacaoCustoTitulo: How much accompaniment you get, and what it costs
mktE10.implantacaoCustoTexto: Onboarding is a one-off payment per venue and it is not the subscription. What changes most between tiers is the time we spend with you.
mktE10.equipamentosProntoTitulo: What is worth having ready, and what is not included
mktE10.equipamentosProntoTexto: The subscription covers the software; the hardware sits apart. What you already own is assessed before anything is bought, and no model is universally compatible without homologation.
mktE10.equipamentoPronto1Texto: A computer or a tablet to administer, and a connection that reaches the floor. With that and the code printed on the table the menu already works: starting may need no new hardware at all.
mktE10.equipamentoPronto2Texto: If the order is taken on the floor, staff devices; if the kitchen reads on a screen, a screen or a device. A TV may need a mini-PC. It depends on how you work, and it is settled at the first step.
mktE10.equipamentoPronto3: If you are going to take payment through the system
mktE10.equipamentoPronto3Texto: The till may call for a terminal, printer, drawer or scanner, depending on the operation. Every model goes through homologation before being signed off, and that is tested before you buy anything.
mktE10.equipamentoPronto4: What is not included, said up front
mktE10.equipamentoPronto4Texto: Purchase, warranty, network, mounting and cabling are not implied by any subscription. Kiosk and marketplace connectors are quoted separately, and until then they are included in no tier.
mktE10.equipamentosSemKit: We sell no closed kit. There is no box that arrives with everything inside: the hardware list comes out of how you work and is settled with you, not before we meet you.
mktE10.implantacaoFechoTitulo: The first step is half an hour
mktE10.implantacaoFechoTexto: Three things come out of that conversation: which tier suits you, what hardware is needed, and when we start.
mktE10.adicionaisTitulo: What is not included, before you ask
mktE10.adicional1: The price is per physical venue
mktE10.adicional1Texto: Two venues are two subscriptions. There is no volume discount written down yet: if you run several, we talk.
mktE10.adicional2Texto: Purchase, warranty, network, mounting and cabling are not included, and no model is compatible without homologation.
mktE10.adicional3Texto: They have no fixed price in this version. They are quoted separately, and until then they are in no tier.
mktE10.adicional4: Direct orders and bookings carry no commission
mktE10.adicional4Texto: What is ordered through your menu or booked through your website pays no percentage: {valor}, and it comes from the pricing source.
mktE10.cobranca1Texto: Up front, at the start of the period. A year costs ten monthly payments, so the monthly equivalent shown beside it is a division for comparison, not what gets charged.
mktE10.cobranca2: Can I move up a tier mid-month?
mktE10.cobranca2Texto: Yes. What you gain switches on once the change is recorded, and the system shows you what changes before you confirm.
mktE10.cobranca3Texto: A downgrade has an effective date and the system shows what you stop having before you accept. Your data and your previous theme are kept.
mktE10.cobranca4: What if I go past the contracted limit?
mktE10.cobranca4Texto: The system tells you with the number in front of you and deletes nothing. What sits above the limit stops growing until the plan covers it.
mktE10.cobranca5Texto: No. Every value on this page is before VAT and per physical venue.
mktE10.contratarTexto: There is no sign-up button on this page, and that is not an oversight: onboarding is accompanied, and it starts with half an hour with you. If you are already a customer, sign in.
mktE10.demoAviso: Bossa Demo is a demonstration restaurant: the dishes, the tables and the order are invented. The screens are the real product, captured from the same build that ships.
mktE10.seoHomeDescricao: Menu, floor, kitchen, bookings and management on one base, with no order retyped by hand between screens.
mktE10.seoProdutoTitulo: The product from the inside · BossaOS
mktE10.seoProdutoDescricao: The catalogue that feeds the public menu, the floor order and the kitchen screen, with captures of the real product.
mktE10.seoPlanosDescricao: Starter, Restaurant and Pro: monthly and yearly price, VAT not included, per venue, and onboarding kept separate from the subscription.
mktE10.seoImplantacaoDescricao: The four steps, how much accompaniment you get, and what is worth having ready before we start. Hardware sits apart.
mktE10.seoPilotoDescricao: What happens in a pilot, what each side commits to, and what you take with you if it goes badly. No third-party names.
mktE10.seoConfiancaDescricao: Your data is yours and exports, the system says what it does not know, and off the network the limit is stated rather than faked.
mktE10.seoPerguntasDescricao: Commercial, technical and hardware objections, answered against what the system does today.
mktE10.seoDemoDescricao: Half an hour with your menu in front of you. Sending the form signs nothing and we write within one working day.
mktE10.seoPrivacidadeDescricao: What the demo form collects, what it is used for, who can read it, and what is not settled yet.
mktE10.seoObrigadoDescricao: Your demo request is saved. We write within one working day to agree a time.
mktE10.ogAlt: The floor of Bossa Demo, the BossaOS demonstration restaurant: open tables and an order in progress, captured from the real product.
mktE10.demoErroCamposTexto: Nothing was saved. The name or the restaurant is missing, or the email is not shaped like an email. Fix it and send again: waiting will not help.
mktE10.demoPassoSeguinte: Sending this signs nothing. We write within one working day to agree a time.
mktE10.demoTratamento: What you write here is used to answer you about this demo. The process serving this site can write your request and cannot read it, and this page sets you no analytics or tracking cookies.
mktE10.demoConsentimento: I would like to receive BossaOS news by email
mktE10.demoConsentimentoNota: Optional, and separate from this request. Leave it unticked and we write only about the demo you asked for. You can tell us to stop by replying to any email.
mktE10.privacidadeTexto: This page describes what the system actually does with what you write in the demo form, and it is written so it can be checked against the code. What is not settled yet is said at the end, rather than filled in with words.
mktE10.privacidadeRecolhaTexto: Your name, your email and the name of the restaurant. The phone and the message only if you write them, because they are optional. And the language you filled the form in, so we answer in it.
mktE10.privacidadeUsoTexto: To answer you and agree the demo you asked for. That contact is the object of your request: asking for a demo is asking to be written to.
mktE10.privacidadeLeituraTexto: The process serving this site can write to that table and cannot read it: the read permission is revoked in the database itself, not in a rule of the program. It is read from the platform control, and by people.
mktE10.privacidadeMarketing: Marketing is a separate tick box
mktE10.privacidadeMarketingTexto: Receiving news is a different decision from asking for a demo, which is why it is a separate box that arrives unticked. If you tick it, it is stored with the date you ticked it, because a consent without a date cannot be checked later. If you do not, no consent is stored.
mktE10.privacidadePendente: What is not here yet, said up front
mktE10.privacidadePendenteTexto: The data controller, the retention period and the procedure for exercising your rights are not settled in this version, and we do not invent them to fill the page. If you need them before giving us any data, write to us and we will put them in writing.
mktE10.altSala: The floor in BossaOS: table 07 on the terrace open with three covers and order A128, and three free tables beside it.
mktE10.altKds: The same order A128 on the kitchen screen: two croquettes in preparation and two more dishes to start, timed from the server.
mktE10.altCatalogo: The restaurant catalogue in BossaOS: six dishes with their category, price and status, ready to go on the menu.
mktE10.altStaff: The server’s phone: order A128 accepted, with its three dishes and prices.
mktE10.altCarta: The menu as the person at the table sees it: dish name, description and price, on the phone.
mktE10.altTablet: The same floor on a tablet, which is the device in the hand of whoever is serving.
mktE10.heroiLegenda: The same order, in both places: taken at the table and showing in the kitchen without anyone writing it again.
mktE10.produtoPaginaTexto: This is not a feature list. These are the product screens, captured from the build that ships, following one single order from start to finish.
mktE10.prodComandaTitulo: One order, from the table to the kitchen
mktE10.prodComandaTexto: The table opens, the order is taken, and the kitchen sees it. In between there is nobody copying anything by hand — which is where time goes and mistakes appear.
mktE10.prodCatalogoTitulo: And it all comes from one catalogue
mktE10.prodCatalogoTexto: The price on the menu, the name that reaches the kitchen and what gets charged at the till are the same line. Change the dish in one place and it changes everywhere.
mktE10.prodCartaTexto: They point at the table code and read today’s menu, with declared allergens and the price that will actually be charged. Nothing to install.
mktE10.prodTabletTitulo: On the device you already have
mktE10.prodTabletTexto: The same floor on a tablet. There is no cut-down mobile version: it is the same screen, composed for the hand holding it.
mktE10.prodFechoTitulo: You have seen it. Now with your own menu.
mktE10.prodFechoTexto: These screens are an invented restaurant. The demo is with yours: your dishes, your prices, your tables. Half an hour, and you leave knowing whether it fits.

temaE12.naoPersonalizavelTexto: Typography, components and state colours (success, warning, danger). A repainted state breaks the reading of an operations screen.
temaE12.herancaTexto: The theme belongs to the organisation and every unit shares it. There is no per-unit override.
temaE12.semAlteracoes: The draft matches what is already published.
temaE12.previaAviso: This is the menu with the draft applied. Nobody else sees it yet.

temaE12.publicarSemDestino: There is no public surface yet. The theme is saved and takes effect as soon as you publish the menu or the site.

temaE12.planoRestauraTexto: You get your colours back. No need to pick them again.

temaE12.nadaParaRestaurar: There is no earlier theme saved.

salaE13.rascunhosDesconhecidos: This device has not reported. There is no way to know how many.
salaE13.avisoRevogar: Removing access DISCARDS any drafts left on the device. They cannot be recovered afterwards.
salaE13.avisoRevogarPorque: A removed device never gets back in, so its owner cannot resolve them. If this is not an emergency, drain it first.
salaE13.pinAjuda: Four to eight digits. It switches operator on this device; it does not let anyone in from outside.
salaE13.pinBloqueado: Too many attempts. Try again later.

salaE13.semFuso: This unit has no time zone configured, so a time written here does not mean anything yet.

pedidosE14.precoDivergente: The price changed since it was written
pedidosE14.avisoDivergente: The official price is the server's at the moment of acceptance. The line is not charged at another price without someone deciding.
pedidosE14.avisoCarrinho: Everything else is still in the order. Nothing was deleted.
pedidosE14.semPedidos: No orders in this service yet.
pedidosE14.conflito: Someone changed this order while you were editing
pedidosE14.conflitoAjuda: Nothing was lost. This is what changed and what you can carry on from.
pedidosE14.naoEReceita: Operational value, not settled revenue. Settlement is another thing and arrives in its own stage.
pedidosE14.semDados: No data for this service yet.
pedidosE14.aceitacaoAutomatica: Automatically accept what has no divergence
pedidosE14.porConfigurarAjuda: No value does not mean unlimited: it means not configured.

staffE15.entregar: Ready to take to the table
staffE15.naoEnviadoAjuda: It is on this phone and has not gone out. Nothing was lost.
staffE15.aguardandoAjuda: It went out, and we do not know what happened yet. On reconnect we ask before repeating.
staffE15.conflitoAjuda: Someone changed this while you were writing. Nothing was deleted.
staffE15.semLigacaoAjuda: You can keep composing. Nothing goes out until it is back.
staffE15.suspensosAjuda: They belong to another shift or another person. They do not go out with your session, and they are not deleted.
staffE15.semRede: This action needs a connection and cannot be queued.
staffE15.divergiu: The price changed: it is not charged without someone deciding.
staffE15.semMesas: No open tables in your area.
staffE15.procurarAjuda: Look for a table, a dish or an order.
staffE15.zonaNoAparelho: It is kept on this phone, and nobody else sees it.
staffE15.semZonas: There are no zones in this unit.
staffE15.semMesasLivres: No free tables. A table waiting to be cleaned is not free.
staffE15.semTotal: Nothing accepted yet, and that is not a total of zero.
staffE15.catalogoAjuda: Tap a dish to prepare it. It is kept on this phone and leaves when the network is back.
staffE15.semCatalogo: There are no dishes in this unit’s menu.
staffE15.detalheAjuda: Today’s price is what gets proposed. If it changes before the order leaves, a person decides: nothing is charged silently.
staffE15.revisaoAjuda: This is what is on this phone and has not left yet.
staffE15.nadaPorRever: Nothing to review: everything on this phone has left.
staffE15.semEstacoes: No devices in this unit. With no device, the alert reaches nowhere.
staffE15.semCursos: No service times defined for this unit.
staffE15.semParaEntregar: Nothing ready to take out yet.
staffE15.semDestinos: There is no other free table to move to.
staffE15.semArtigosCancelaveis: There are no items that can be cancelled.
staffE15.cancelarAjuda: Cancelling does not erase: it stays in the order’s history, with who did it.
staffE15.contaAjuda: The total adds up what was accepted, at the price it was accepted for. The menu may change; this bill does not.
staffE15.semResultados: Nothing matches what you are looking for.
staffE15.sairAjuda: Closing your shift stops showing what you wrote: the content stops being readable to whoever comes next, and nothing is erased.
staffE15.ligacaoAjuda: Here you see what this phone knows about the network, and what is still to leave.
staffE15.outraPessoaAjuda: Nothing was erased. Below is what exists now, so you can carry on instead of redoing it.
staffE15.nadaPrecisaAtencao: Nothing needs your attention right now.
staffE15.quemRecebeAjuda: Each alert reaches a station. A station with no device receives nothing, and that is said here instead of assumed.
staffE15.descricaoDaApp: Floor ordering, and it keeps working with no network.
staffE15.pagamentoNoServidor: With a connection, charging is the server’s decision. This screen prepares the bill and changes the table state: it does not charge.
staffE15.esteAparelhoAjuda: Pick which of the unit’s devices this one is. It lets whoever revokes its access see how many drafts will be discarded — a number, never what they say.
staffE15.semDispositivosNaUnidade: There are no active devices in this unit, so there is none to associate it with.
staffE15.sessaoMorreuAjuda: Nothing was sent and nothing was erased. Sign in again and what is on this phone will go out then.

erros.mesa_destino_ocupada: The destination table was taken in the meantime. The origin was left as it was.
erros.sessao_desconhecida: That table is no longer open.
erros.ja_fechada: That table has already been closed.
erros.linha_desconhecida: That item is no longer in the order.

kdsE16.batimentoNaoProva: A device that is “active” but did not print the ticket is still active, and the kitchen does not know. What is shown is the last real result.
kdsE16.estacaoSemLigacao: This station has not reported in. Whatever is pending is still here and counted — nothing was lost.
kdsE16.ligarCozinhaAjuda: Create this unit’s stations and say what each one prepares. With no rules, what gets ordered shows up as unrouted — and that is on purpose.
kdsE16.limiteVisivel: How many tickets are shown at once
kdsE16.limiteVisivelAjuda: It is a screen rule, not a queue rule. What does not fit stays waiting and counted: nothing is dropped for lack of room.
kdsE16.motivoDaPrioridade: A priority with no reason is a decision nobody can review after the shift.
kdsE16.motivoObrigatorio: Cancelling something already in preparation needs a reason: the time and ingredients are already spent, and that gets recorded.
kdsE16.naoEncaminhadoAjuda: Nobody decided which station makes it. It is not sent to the likeliest one: that would be inventing your decision and hiding that it was invented.
kdsE16.semBilhetes: Nothing to prepare at this station.
kdsE16.semEspera: Nothing waiting: it all fits on screen.
kdsE16.semEstacoes: There are no stations in this unit. With no station, what gets ordered reaches nowhere.
kdsE16.semHistorico: Nothing resolved in this shift yet.
kdsE16.semRegras: No routing rules. Every dish ordered will show up as unrouted.
kdsE16.tempoDoServidor: Time is counted from the server stamp, never from this tablet’s clock.

visitanteE17.qrJaNaoActivo: This QR is no longer active
visitanteE17.revejaEsgotado: Check the item that ran out
visitanteE17.rodarAjuda: Changes the code that opens NEW sessions. Whoever is already seated keeps eating: changing expels nobody, and that is why it can be done often.
visitanteE17.revogarAjuda: Closes the sessions open right now at this table. It is the exception: the photo of the QR that showed up in a group chat, or the customer receiving orders they did not place.
visitanteE17.nenhumaVaiCair: No open session at this table right now.
visitanteE17.continuaramAjuda: Changing the QR does not touch them: whoever was already seated keeps ordering with the access they had.
visitanteE17.segredoUmaVez: Print this code now. It is not shown again: the database keeps the digest, not the secret.
visitanteE17.semQr: This table has no QR yet.
visitanteE17.comQueFrequencia: How often it is changed is the restaurant’s call. The system says when it last happened; it brings no default policy.
visitanteE17.semVisitantes: No QR table sessions in this unit.
visitanteE17.entrarAjuda: A session opens for this table. It ends when the bill is closed.
visitanteE17.carrinhoVazio: You have not added anything yet.
visitanteE17.semPedidos: You have not sent any order yet.
visitanteE17.semTotal: Nothing accepted yet, and that is not a total of zero.
visitanteE17.qrJaNaoActivoAjuda: The restaurant may have changed the code, or this table may not be in service. Ask the team for a new one.
visitanteE17.sessaoTerminouAjuda: The bill was closed and this access with it. What you ordered is still on the table’s order: nothing was lost.
visitanteE17.esgotadoAjuda: It was not charged, and the rest of the order stands. Pick something else or ask the team.
visitanteE17.chamarAjuda: Someone on the floor will see it on their screen. No need to raise your hand.
visitanteE17.pedirContaAjuda: We will tell the team. Payment happens with a person: this screen does not charge.
visitanteE17.avisamosAgora: We told the team. Someone is coming.
visitanteE17.jaTinhamosAvisado: We already told them a moment ago. No need to press again: it is still on their screen.
visitanteE17.jaFoiAtendida: Someone on the team has seen it and is on the way.
visitanteE17.chamadasDaMesa: What you asked the floor for

reservasE18.regrasAjuda: Checking a time does not hold the table: confirmation verifies everything again.
reservasE18.capacidadeAjuda: The cap counts guests, not tables. A combined table occupies its components.
reservasE18.turnosAjuda: Local time of the venue. A shift ending before it starts crosses midnight.
reservasE18.bloqueiosAjuda: A block closes the whole venue, one zone, or one table. Never two at once.
reservasE18.politicasAjuda: Releasing a late reservation is the host's call, never a silent sweep.
reservasE18.preferenciasAjuda: With reservations off, the venue accepts none.
reservasE18.bufferAjuda: The buffer goes in before the maths: 90 min with a 15 min buffer occupies 105.
reservasE18.retencaoAjuda: The hold expires by clock: nobody has to open this screen to free the table.
reservasE18.depositoAjuda: Not a missing feature: it stays off until there is commercial policy, payment and cancellation handling.

reservaE19.horaAjuda: These times are indicative: the table is confirmed at the end, not now.
reservaE19.marketing: I'd like news from the restaurant
reservaE19.marketingAjuda: Optional, and separate from the contact the booking needs.
reservaE19.confirmadaTexto: See you soon. Keep this link to manage your booking.
reservaE19.semMesaTexto: We have no table for your group at that time.
reservaE19.semAlternativas: We have no slot for your group today.
reservaE19.posicao: You are {posicao} of {de} groups that fit the same tables
reservaE19.estimativaTexto: We reckon about {minutos} minutes. That's an estimate, not a booked time: it can change.
reservaE19.prontoTexto: Your table is ready. Come to the entrance.
reservaE19.semLugar: For a group your size we have no table tonight. We'd rather say so now.
reservaE19.desligado: We're not taking bookings here right now.
reservaE19.muitos: We're getting a lot of bookings. Try again in a few minutes.
reservaE19.horaInexistente: That time doesn't exist that night (clocks go forward). We booked you at
reservaE19.horaAmbigua: That time happens twice that night (clocks go back). We booked you at

hostE19.atrasadasAjuda: The system releases none of them: giving the table to another group is your call.
hostE19.chegadaAjuda: Marking arrival does not seat the group. The table is assigned when it's ready.
hostE19.aChegarAjuda: Free now, with a booking on the way.
hostE19.definicaoChegadas: Arrivals: guests from bookings that START in that hour, cancellations excluded. A 90-minute booking counts only in its starting hour.
hostE19.ordemAjuda: This is the order they arrived in, not the order they get seated in.
hostE19.chamar: Tell them the table is ready

mensagensE19.conectorAjuda: With no provider nothing is sent, and no message will show as sent.
mensagensE19.reenviarAjuda: Resending does not deliver twice: if it already arrived, the attempt is recorded and the guest does not get it again.
mensagensE19.defCovers: Covers: sum of guests from non-cancelled bookings starting in the period.
mensagensE19.defReservas: Bookings: count of non-cancelled bookings starting in the period.
mensagensE19.defCancelamento: Cancellation: cancelled divided by ALL bookings requested for the period, cancelled included.
mensagensE19.defNoShow: No-show: count of BOOKINGS the host marked as no-show. It counts bookings, not people, and it never happens on its own.
mensagensE19.defOrigem: From the web: public-origin bookings over all non-cancelled ones.

levarE20.porEntrarAjuda: They come in on their own when their moment arrives. Nobody has to open anything.
levarE20.emRiscoAjuda: There's time to tell whoever ordered. The system does not decide what to do.
levarE20.semAreasAjuda: With no zone configured we don't deliver, and no fee is invented.
levarE20.conectorAjuda: Off means no external orders are accepted. None sits waiting for someone to collect it.
levarE20.semMapasAjuda: With no map the product is not guessed: guessing on an order is serving something else.
levarE20.foraDaArea: We don't deliver to that postcode.
levarE20.semTakeaway: This plan does not include takeaway
levarE20.semDelivery: This plan does not include delivery

tpvE22.anularAjuda: Voiding returns no money: it only undoes what was never captured.
tpvE22.apenasDinheiro: Only cash goes in here. Card does not enter the drawer as notes.
tpvE22.divergenciaAjuda: A difference only closes with authorisation, and who signed it stays.
tpvE22.divisaoAjuda: The parts add up to the total exactly. The leftover cent goes to the first ones.
tpvE22.esperadoAjuda: Expected comes from the movements: float plus in minus out.
tpvE22.motivoAjuda: Without a reason, a discount is indistinguishable from a typo.
tpvE22.reconciliarAjuda: An attempt with no answer did not fail: it is unknown. Reconcile before charging again.
tpvE22.reverteAjuda: A correction is a new record. The original stays in sight.
tpvE22.semFiscal: This is not a fiscal document.
tpvE22.semProvedor: No payment provider connected: card is recorded, not charged.
tpvE22.transferirAjuda: What is already paid does not move.
tpvE22.trocoAjuda: Change is received minus owed. It is not revenue.

pagamentoE23.dividir: How do you want to split?
pagamentoE23.divisaoAjuda: The parts add up to the total exactly. The leftover cent goes to the first ones.
pagamentoE23.emComprovacao: The payment is still being checked
pagamentoE23.emComprovacaoAjuda: Do not try again: if it went through, it shows here. Paying again is paying twice.
pagamentoE23.integracaoPendente: Provider integration: PENDING. Nothing here has talked to a bank.
pagamentoE23.pingNaoProva: A terminal answering does not prove the charge arrived.
pagamentoE23.retornoNaoProva: Coming back to this screen does not confirm a payment. The bank confirms it.
pagamentoE23.segredoFora: The provider key is not stored here: it lives on the server.
pagamentoE23.semAdquirente: No payment provider connected yet: payment is taken by a person.
pagamentoE23.semRecibo: We could not find that receipt.

fiscalE24.emissaoBloqueada: Real issuance BLOCKED: no approved provider connected.
fiscalE24.naoEDocumento: This is NOT a fiscal document.
fiscalE24.porConfirmar: Regime requirements TO BE CONFIRMED at the official source. See ADR 0002.

stockE25.arvore: Selling a dish deducts the real ingredients, descending through sub-recipes.
stockE25.consumoQuando: Consumption is recorded when served. Cancelling before production consumes nothing.
stockE25.negativoVisivel: A negative balance shows here. It does not block service, but it does not go away on its own.
stockE25.saldoDerivado: The balance is the sum of the movements: it is not written, it is derived.

comprasE26.factorAjuda: A 25 kg sack is not one unit: it is 25,000 g. Without a factor, it is refused.
comprasE26.metodo: Weighted moving average, derived from entries
comprasE26.soRecepcaoMexe: Only receiving moves stock: an order is an intention and an invoice is paper.
comprasE26.tresNumeros: Ordered, received and invoiced are three numbers, not three states of one.

crmE27.audienciaPorRegra: Who is included is decided by rule, evaluated at send time. Never by a pasted list.
crmE27.retiradaVale: Withdrawing consent takes effect before the next send, not from the next campaign.
crmE27.saldoDerivado: The balance is derived from movements. There is no column anyone increments.
crmE27.semEnvioReal: No sending provider is contracted: deliveries are recorded as TO SEND.
crmE27.servicoNaoDaCampanha: Data given to provide service does not grant campaign permission. A phone number left so someone could be told their table was ready is not a marketing list.

pontoE28.abertaExplica: Clocked in and has not clocked out. That is not a zero day: it is an open one.
pontoE28.diaDeServico: A shift crossing midnight belongs to the day it started. Someone who left at 00:42 on Saturday worked on Friday.
pontoE28.marcacaoEhFacto: A punch is not rewritten. Correcting it is a new record, with author and reason, and the original stays.
pontoE28.minutosInteiros: Time is stored in whole minutes, never in hours with a decimal point.
pontoE28.quemCorrige: Whoever corrects is recorded, and a self-correction is distinguishable from a correction by someone else.

financeiroE29.conciliadoDerivado: Reconciled is not a checkbox: a confirmed match exists, therefore it is reconciled.
financeiroE29.fecharProibe: Closing forbids new movements dated inside. It copies no totals: an adjustment is born in the open period pointing at the closed one.
financeiroE29.moedasNaoSomam: Currencies are not added together. Either grouped, or converted with the source and date in plain sight.
financeiroE29.nadaAutoConfirma: No match confirms itself, not even at a perfect score. Confirming leaves an author and a moment.
financeiroE29.silencioEhDefeito: An import that silently ignores lines is indistinguishable from one that never read the file.
financeiroE29.tresDatas: Occurrence, value and record are three different dates. Cash uses the value date; result uses the occurrence. “How much came in” and “how much did I sell” are different questions.

analiticaE30.ausenciaNaoEZero: Absence is not zero. “€0” says the house opened and sold nothing; no data says nobody knows. Whoever reads the first one closes the lunch shift.
analiticaE30.clonaConfiguracao: Catalogue and configuration are copied; never orders or customers. And the difference is shown before applying.
analiticaE30.denominador: The average is computed at the end, over the sums and counts together. An average of averages is wrong whenever the denominators differ.
analiticaE30.desceAOrigem: From every indicator you reach the transaction, without leaving the screen.
analiticaE30.duplicar: Copy a menu to another unit
analiticaE30.exportaOQueVe: The export uses this screen’s filters. Same content, same definition.
analiticaE30.naoConsolida: Two organisations are not added together because the person is the same. They are seen one at a time.
analiticaE30.porUnidade: The period is resolved in each unit’s timezone, and only then summed. “Yesterday” is not the same interval in two timezones.
analiticaE30.semDadosExplica: Nobody measured: this is not the same as zero.
analiticaE30.semDemonstracao: An empty panel is shown empty. It is never filled with invented data.
analiticaE30.zeroExplica: The house opened and sold nothing. It is a fact, and a bad one.

kioskE31.entregueNaoEImpresso: «Handed to the bridge» is not «it printed»
kioskE31.fallbackAjuda: When the printer doesn't answer, the ticket is read here. The kitchen isn't left in the dark.
kioskE31.kiosksVazio: No kiosks in this location yet
kioskE31.naoSeiAjuda: It went out and nobody answered. We don't say it printed and we don't say it failed: someone has to go and look.
kioskE31.pausadoCobranca: There's an unresolved charge on this terminal. Staff must check it before serving anyone else.
kioskE31.pausadoNaoAprovado: This terminal isn't authorised yet. Please tell a member of staff.
kioskE31.porTestarAjuda: Nobody has checked this against the physical printer. That is not the same as «it fails».
kioskE31.recolher: Collect your order when your number shows
kioskE31.recomecarAjuda: Clears the screen for the next person
kioskE31.reimprimirAjuda: The copy is marked on the paper, so the kitchen doesn't read it as a new order
kioskE31.semLigacaoAviso: You can browse, but right now we can't take payment or confirm the order. Nobody is making anything yet.

integracoesE32.chaveUmaVezAjuda: This is the only time it's shown. We keep only a digest: if you lose it, create another and revoke this one.
integracoesE32.destinoAjuda: https only, and never an internal network address
integracoesE32.doisDinheiros: Two separate books, and they are never added together
integracoesE32.naoLigada: This integration isn't connected. That's not a failure: nobody has set it up yet, and we'd rather say so than pretend it works.
integracoesE32.revogarAjuda: Cuts access immediately, not on the next cycle
integracoesE32.semProvedorAjuda: There is no account and no keys. We say so instead of looking connected.
integracoesE32.semVinculoAjuda: They arrived, the signature checks out, and no customer of ours is linked. They change nothing.

plataformaE33.exigeConsentimentoAjuda: Nobody from support comes in without someone here approving it
plataformaE33.expiraSozinha: It expires on its own. It doesn't depend on anyone remembering to close it.
plataformaE33.migracaoAviso: These tools move a customer's data. Each one leaves a trail with your name and the reason.
plataformaE33.nuncaAtrasDoPlano: Security, privacy and export never depend on the plan
plataformaE33.nuncaAtrasDoPlanoAjuda: Your venue protects its data, exports it and answers an access request on any plan. What depends on the plan is convenience.
plataformaE33.papelNaoEPessoa: The trail keeps the person, not the role. «Support» doesn't answer who did this.
plataformaE33.reprocessarAjuda: Retrying doesn't duplicate: it's the next attempt
plataformaE33.retencaoAjuda: Empty means «not decided», not «forever». The actual policy depends on legal advice, and we're not going to invent a number for you.
plataformaE33.segredoNuncaSeVe: The value isn't here. It lives in the authorised environment, and there is no column it could fit in.
plataformaE33.semSessoes: Nobody from support has been in here
plataformaE33.semTickets: You haven't opened any requests yet
plataformaE33.tectoAjuda: Support may ask for less; never for more
plataformaE33.vemosOQuePrecisamos: We see only what we need to fix it, not the whole venue.
plataformaE33.vesTudo: You see every support visit, with who, when and why. If something looks wrong, tell us.
